claims.claim: I haven't really noticed any decay in our neighborhood, to be honest. It feels like there's always something new happening, and people seem to be looking out for each other. I mean, just the other day I saw a new face at the Telegraph Presbyterian Fellowship, and that's a great sign that our community is still growing and welcoming. As for initiatives, I think we've got a good thing going with the way our neighborhood comes together to support each other, even if it's not always formal or official.
